r01-couple-cat.observed_description: On a grey sofa in the family's living room the mother (long wavy brown hair, coral shirt) and the father (dark hair, short beard, blue shirt) sit side by side turned toward each other: he speaks with his mouth open and one hand raised, she looks at him and laughs; a gold wedding ring shows on each left hand. The grey tabby cat with the blue collar lies curled on the sofa beside her with both eyes closed, its head on her leg. Shelves with small framed photos and plants are behind; nothing readable. No children, cups, food or phone. Nobody looks at the camera.
r01-couple-cat.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the couple talking and the cat sleeping both read down to 180 px.

r02-son-dog-playing.observed_description: On a sunny garden lawn in front of a wooden fence the family's boy (blue short-sleeved shirt, dark shorts) leans back laughing and pulls a thick blue rope with both hands while the golden-tan dog with the white chest and red collar holds the other end in its mouth and pulls back, tail up. Neither is running. No ball, other person or animal; nothing readable.
r02-son-dog-playing.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): a tug-of-war game reads as playing together down to 180 px, clearly different from the 1.11 running photo.

r03-daughter-friend-reading.observed_description: On a grey sofa in a bright living room the family's girl (long dark-brown hair in a ponytail, lilac T-shirt) and her friend (very curly black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt) sit close together with one large open picture book across their laps, both looking down at it and smiling; the friend points at a page. The pages show only colored shapes and faint lines, no letters. Bookshelves and a plant are softly blurred behind; nothing readable. No adults, animals, ball or toys.
r03-daughter-friend-reading.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): two girls reading one book together reads down to 180 px.

r04-rabbit-bird-eating.observed_description: On a light wooden floor in front of a sofa the white rabbit with light-brown patches and upright ears holds a green lettuce leaf in its mouth, with two more leaves on the floor in front of it; beside it the yellow-headed green parakeet perches on the rim of a small white dish of seeds with its beak lowered to the seeds. No other animal, person, hand, cage or water dish; nothing readable.
r04-rabbit-bird-eating.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): both animals are clearly eating down to 180 px.

r05-people-person.observed_description: On a gravel path in a park four adults stand in a small group on the left and talk: a woman with grey curly hair gesturing as she speaks, a bearded younger man speaking, a blonde woman and an older man with glasses smiling at them. On the right, apart from them, one adult in a long beige coat and a grey knitted hat sits alone on a wooden bench, seen from the side, hands in the lap, looking ahead. Empty benches and trees behind; far in the background a few tiny blurred figures and a blurred playground. No children near, no animals, phones or text.
r05-people-person.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): a talking group and one separate sitting person both read down to 180 px. The seated person reads as a woman at large sizes; the sentence only says a person.
